prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Houston, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1450; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. I'll note the claimant's name is on file. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving through an intersection in Houston, making a left turn onto a side street.
Q: Which direction were you traveling before the turn?
A: I was heading north on a main road, and I was turning left toward a shopping center.
Q: What did you see as you began the turn?
A: There was an oncoming vehicle, and I thought it was far enough away. I started my turn and it came in pretty quickly.
Q: Did the light facing you show green, yellow, or red?
A: It was green for me. I think it had been green for a few seconds.
Q: How fast were you going when you started the turn?
A: Not fast. I was slowing down for the intersection, probably in the range of ten or fifteen miles an hour.
Q: Did the other driver's vehicle hit your car on the driver's side or passenger side?
A: It hit the front passenger side of my car, near the front wheel.
Q: Did you have any injuries at the scene?
A: My lower back hurt right away, and I had a stiff neck. I didn't think much of it at first.
Q: Have you sought medical care since the accident?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same day, and they told me I had a back strain. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week.
Q: Are you currently working?
A: I'm on light duty for now. Sitting for long periods makes the pain worse.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add or correct in your statement?
A: No, I think that covers it. I'm just hoping this gets resolved so I can get back to normal.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
